objective: Review the importable non-executing native-invocation fixture after the accepted direct command-path native invocation boundary, accept only metadata validation for a real Verilator-facing argv plus explicit sidecar context, and select a definition-only execution boundary without claiming native option support, direct Verilator command execution, sidecar execution, compare execution, timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality.

review_decision.reason: The implementation stays inside the reviewed non-executing fixture boundary: it rejects wrapper-first argv, requires a Verilator-facing argv before the argv path can return metadata, requires an exact explicit sidecar context keyset, reuses the reviewed direct command-path fixture and parser payload validation, preserves ordinary Verilator build inputs as inputs only, and keeps all runtime authority, generated-command authority, materialized-stage-plan authority, execution, timing, allocation, runtime/ABI, and source-closure flags false.
review_decision.weakest_point: The word native can still be over-read. The helper accepts native-looking argv metadata, but it never invokes a Verilator process and does not prove the upstream Verilator binary accepts or executes these options. The next gate may define an execution boundary, but it must remain definition-only and must require a real Verilator process, reviewed sidecar context, explicit stage authority, generated evidence boundaries, and coverage-output comparison rules before any command can run.

focused contract tests cover accepted argv, accepted parser payload, wrapper rejection, compact shape rejection, sidecar-owned parser-field rejection, and gate non-claims
